title: Output of Google Sheets Import & Export
description: Write: the OUTPUT record says what was written. Read: sheet rows go to the default dataset as JSON rows keyed by the header row.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: JSON. Write example: {"operation":"write","spreadsheetUrl":"https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/…","sheetName":"Sheet1","rowsWritten":250,"duplicatesSkipped":3,"columns":["name","price"],"zeroResultsReason":null}. Read adds rowsRead and range. Errors: {"error":"Can't open spreadsheet …: share the sheet with …"}.

results.title: Imported rows
results.description: Read operation: one JSON row per sheet row, e.g. {"Student Name":"Alexandra","Home State":"CA","Major":"English"}. 0 rows read gives one free row {"status":"no_results","reason":"…"}.
